mapper.sql: id, type, order_sub_item_id, before_return_number, return_number, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, tenant_id, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT sal_yt_return_order.*, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = sal_yt_return_order.create_user) as returnUserName FROM sal_yt_return_order WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT syro.*,syosi.specification_id,syosi.product_id, pyp.code as productCode FROM sal_yt_return_order as syro left join sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi on syosi.id= syro.order_sub_item_id left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = syosi.product_id WHERE type = #{type} AND order_sub_item_id =#{orderSubItemId} AND syro.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY syro.create_time DESC

SELECT syro.*,syosi.specification_id,syosi.product_id, pyp.code as productCode FROM sal_yt_return_order as syro left join sal_yt_order_sub_item as syosi on syosi.id= syro.order_sub_item_id left join pro_yt_product as pyp on pyp.id = syosi.product_id WHERE type = #{type} AND syro.purchase_item_id = #{purchaseItemId} AND syro.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY syro.create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(return_number), 0) FROM sal_yt_return_order WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT syosi.specification_id, syosi.product_id, pyp.code as productCode, -- 获取最早的退货记录的before_return_number作为初始数量 (SELECT before_return_number FROM sal_yt_return_order WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT 1) as initial_number, -- 统计总退货数量 COALESCE(SUM(syro.return_number), 0) as total_return_number, -- 计算剩余数量 = 初始数量 - 总退货数量 ((SELECT before_return_number FROM sal_yt_return_order WHERE order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT 1) - COALESCE(SUM(syro.return_number), 0)) as remaining_number, -- 关联退货记录详情 syro.id as ro_id, syro.type as ro_type, syro.order_sub_item_id as ro_order_sub_item_id, syro.before_return_number as ro_before_return_number, syro.return_number as ro_return_number, syro.reason as ro_reason, syro.create_time as ro_create_time FROM sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi LEFT JOIN pro_yt_product pyp ON pyp.id = syosi.product_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_return_order syro ON syro.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id WHERE syosi.id = #{orderSubItemId} AND syosi.is_deleted = 0 AND (syro.is_deleted = 0 OR syro.is_deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY syosi.specification_id ORDER BY syosi.specification_id

SELECT syro.* FROM sal_yt_return_order syro JOIN sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi ON syro.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id WHERE syro.order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId} AND syosi.specification_id = #{specificationId} AND syro.is_deleted = 0 AND syosi.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY syro.create_time DESC

SELECT syosi.specification_id, pyp.id as productId, pyp.code as productCode, -- 统计总退货数量 COALESCE(SUM(syro.return_number), 0) as total_return_number, -- 获取第一笔退货记录的beforeReturnNumber作为初始数量 first_return.before_return_number as initial_number, -- 计算剩余数量 = 初始数量(第一笔退货的beforeReturnNumber) - 总退货数量 (first_return.before_return_number - COALESCE(SUM(syro.return_number), 0)) as remaining_number, -- 关联退货记录详情 syro.id as ro_id, syro.type as ro_type, syro.order_sub_item_id as ro_order_sub_item_id, syro.before_return_number as ro_before_return_number, syro.return_number as ro_return_number, syro.reason as ro_reason, syro.create_time as ro_create_time, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = syro.create_user) as returnUserName FROM sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi LEFT JOIN sal_yt_return_order syro ON syro.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id LEFT JOIN pro_yt_product pyp ON pyp.id = syosi.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_sub_item_id, before_return_number FROM ( SELECT order_sub_item_id, before_return_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_sub_item_id ORDER BY create_time ASC) as rn FROM sal_yt_return_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) t WHERE rn = 1 ) first_return ON first_return.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id WHERE syosi.order_sub_id = #{params.orderSubId} AND syosi.is_deleted = 0
AND syosi.product_id = #{params.productId}
AND pyp.code like concat('%',#{params.productCode},'%')
AND syosi.specification_id in (select product_specification_id from pro_yt_product_specification_item where category_specification_item_id in (select id from pro_yt_category_specification_item where value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.specificationName}, '%')))
GROUP BY syosi.order_sub_id,syosi.specification_id ORDER BY syosi.specification_id

SELECT pyri.id as purchaseItemId, pyri.specification_id as specificationId, pyri.product_id as productId, (select code from pro_yt_product where id = pyri.product_id )as productCode, COUNT(ryro.id) as totalReturnCount, SUM(ryro.return_number) as totalReturnNumber, MAX(first_return.before_return_number) as initialNumber, (MAX(first_return.before_return_number) - SUM(ryro.return_number)) as currentNumber FROM pur_yt_purchase_item pyri LEFT JOIN sal_yt_return_order ryro ON pyri.id = ryro.purchase_item_id AND ryro.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT purchase_item_id, before_return_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY purchase_item_id ORDER BY create_time ASC) as rn FROM sal_yt_return_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type = 2 ) first_return ON first_return.purchase_item_id = pyri.id AND first_return.rn = 1 WHERE pyri.id = #{purchaseItemId} AND pyri.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY pyri.id, pyri.specification_id ORDER BY pyri.specification_id

SELECT ryro.*, syosi.specification_id as specificationId, syosi.product_id as productId, (select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = ryro.create_user) as returnUserName FROM sal_yt_return_order ryro LEFT JOIN sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi ON ryro.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id WHERE ryro.is_deleted = 0 AND ( (ryro.type = 2 AND ryro.purchase_item_id = #{purchaseItemId}) OR (ryro.type = 1 AND ryro.order_sub_item_id = #{orderSubItemId}) ) ORDER BY ryro.create_time DESC

SELECT ANY_VALUE(syosi.order_sub_id) as orderSubId, ANY_VALUE(syosi.label_id) as labelId, ANY_VALUE(syosi.price) as price, ANY_VALUE(syosi.supplier_price) as supplierPrice, ANY_VALUE(syosi.remark) as remark, syosi.specification_id, ANY_VALUE(pyp.id) as productId, ANY_VALUE(pyp.code) as productCode, COALESCE(SUM(syro.return_number), 0) as total_return_number, ANY_VALUE(first_return.before_return_number) as initial_number, (ANY_VALUE(first_return.before_return_number) - COALESCE(SUM(syro.return_number), 0)) as remaining_number, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.ro_id) as ro_id, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.ro_type) as ro_type, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.ro_order_sub_item_id) as ro_order_sub_item_id, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.ro_before_return_number) as ro_before_return_number, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.ro_return_number) as ro_return_number, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.ro_reason) as ro_reason, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.ro_create_time) as ro_create_time, ANY_VALUE(ro_detail.returnUserName) as returnUserName FROM sal_yt_order_sub_item syosi INNER JOIN sal_yt_order_sub syos ON syos.id = syosi.order_sub_id LEFT JOIN sal_yt_return_order syro ON syro.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id LEFT JOIN pro_yt_product pyp ON pyp.id = syosi.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_sub_item_id, before_return_number FROM ( SELECT order_sub_item_id, before_return_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_sub_item_id ORDER BY create_time ASC) as rn FROM sal_yt_return_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) t WHERE rn = 1 ) first_return ON first_return.order_sub_item_id = syosi.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT syro_inner.id as ro_id, syro_inner.type as ro_type, syro_inner.order_sub_item_id as ro_order_sub_item_id, syro_inner.before_return_number as ro_before_return_number, syro_inner.return_number as ro_return_number, syro_inner.reason as ro_reason, syro_inner.create_time as ro_create_time, (SELECT nick_name FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = syro_inner.create_user) as returnUserName FROM sal_yt_return_order syro_inner WHERE syro_inner.is_deleted = 0 ) ro_detail ON ro_detail.ro_order_sub_item_id = syosi.id WHERE syos.order_id = #{params.orderId} AND syosi.is_deleted = 0 AND syos.is_deleted = 0
AND syosi.product_id = #{params.productId}
AND pyp.code like concat('%',#{params.productCode},'%')
AND syosi.specification_id in (select product_specification_id from pro_yt_product_specification_item where category_specification_item_id in (select id from pro_yt_category_specification_item where value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.specificationName}, '%')))
GROUP BY syosi.specification_id ORDER BY syosi.specification_id
